hint_ladder.title: Negative multiplier
hint_ladder.prompt: The outside multiplier is -2, so it must multiply both x and -5.

hint_ladder.title: Second product
hint_ladder.prompt: Calculate -2 times -5 carefully: two negatives make a positive.

hint_ladder.title: Sign slip
hint_ladder.prompt: The sign trap is the second multiplication: -2 times -5 is positive, so the constant term should not stay negative.
